about: The source-labelled fragments the incident operator already captured for the checkout incident.

incident_fragments.text: 03:12 UTC alert fired: checkout 5xx rate crossed 8 percent.
03:02 UTC deploy 2026.08.09.3 rolled out a connection pool change to checkout-api.
03:40 UTC rollback of 2026.08.09.3 completed and 5xx rate returned to baseline.
04:20 UTC investigation confirmed the pool maximum was reduced to one connection while 100 workers were active; saturation caused checkout timeouts. platform-oncall owns pool saturation alerting.
